shots.title: Group walk & trip
shots.framing: wide, low-angle dolly back, slow motion
shots.motion: Slow-motion low-angle dolly back: five costumed heroes walk abreast through drifting smoke, capes billowing, confident stride; the tall red hero trips on his own dragging cape and stumbles sideways into the short yellow hero, both lurching out of formation while the other three keep striding, oblivious.
shots.audio: epic orchestral swell, slow-motion whoosh, a stumble thud, muffled yelp

shots.title: Superhero landing fail
shots.motion: High-angle crane shot pushing in: the blue-armored hero drops onto a rooftop AC unit in a three-point superhero landing; the sheet-metal unit crumples and collapses under him and he flails as he sinks into it, dust bursting outward.
shots.audio: dramatic bass hit, sheet metal crumpling, clattering, a startled grunt

shots.title: Wall-run slide
shots.motion: Side tracking shot in a narrow brick alley at dusk: the purple-hoodied skinny hero sprints at the wall, takes two running steps up the bricks, stalls mid-stride, and slowly slides down flat against the wall to the pavement, palms dragging.
shots.audio: running footsteps, long sneaker squeak against brick, soft body flop, pigeons flapping

shots.title: Cat rescue backfire
shots.motion: Medium shot up into an oak tree: the stocky yellow hero in a colander helmet inches along a branch reaching toward a calm tabby cat; the branch cracks and snaps, he crashes down through foliage onto the grass, and the cat hops down gracefully onto his chest.
shots.audio: creaking wood, a sharp crack, rustling leaves, heavy thump, soft meow

shots.title: Billboard swing
shots.motion: Wide shot between rooftops at dusk: the huge green-clad bodybuilder hero swings across on a grappling rope in a heroic arc, then pendulums straight into a large billboard, smacking flat against it and sliding down slowly out of frame.
shots.audio: rope whoosh, rushing wind, a loud hollow boom on impact, slow squeak of sliding

shots.title: Glass door pileup
shots.motion: Steadicam front view at night: all five heroes charge shoulder-to-shoulder toward a glass storefront, screaming battle cries; the automatic sliding door fails to open and they pile into the glass one after another, squashed faces and capes, the door wobbling.
shots.audio: battle cries, pounding footsteps, repeated dull thumps on glass, overlapping groans

shots.title: Title pose collapse
shots.motion: Slow push-in through swirling smoke at night: the five heroes hold a dramatic tiered team pose; the tall red hero wobbles first and they collapse onto each other in a domino chain, ending in a groaning heap as the smoke drifts across.
shots.audio: final orchestral stinger, a wobble, cascading thuds, a weak group groan
